notes.title: Isekai Spa Simulator "Magical Massage” first PV release! Playtest starts now!
notes.notes: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45468587/7056de68b8798f153b0a11b2c2d9069d8a5f5212.png"][/img][/p][p]Ever wondered if hemorrhoids could cause earthquakes? Or if massage could cure them? Or if the treatment might put your life at risk?[/p][p]Hello, players! This is Pop Elephant here![/p][p]The public playtest of Magical Massage is now live on Steam![/p][p]Head over to the game page to request access and be among the first to experience this bizarre and absurd magical massage adventure![/p][p]In the game, you take on the role of a massage therapist who specializes in treating magicians’ most embarrassing conditions—like hemorrhoids that trigger earthquakes or explosive sinusitis. With your divine hands, it’s all up to you to save the day![/p][p]Each client will also start rambling nonsense under your hypnosis (uh... maybe this is the perfect time to upsell them on a VIP membership^^)[/p][p]Currently, Magical Massage is still in early development, and some parts are being refined. If you encounter any bugs or have eager feedback and suggestions while playing, feel free to join our official QQ group 1046610890. Who knows—your brilliant ideas might make it into the final version of the game![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45468587/07374dcd78b8b7c6809311928179e20eb9a05de8.png"][/img][/p][p]We’ve worked hard to improve the game based on feedback from the first test! In this round, several new massageable characters have been added, and we hope they bring you a fresh experience![/p]
